Armor.LightDesc: Padded, leather, and other unrestrictive armor that barely slows you down.
Armor.MediumDesc: Mail and scale — a balance of protection and mobility.
Armor.HeavyDesc: Plate and other full armor — maximum protection at the cost of agility.

Spell.NoPermission: No permission to apply the spell's effect to {name}.

Effect.Label: Effects
Effect.GateMinHint: Applies only while proficiency with this item is at least this value (0 = no proficiency gate).
Effect.GateUnderHint: Armor only: applies only while your armor proficiency is BELOW the armor's required proficiency.
Effect.GateNote: Effects apply only while the item is equipped. Set a minimum proficiency to gate a property; for armor, 'Penalty' applies only while under-trained.

Versatile.Label: Versatile
Versatile.Desc: Can be wielded in one or two hands.

Light.Label: Light
Light.Desc: Small and easily handled — well suited to an off hand.

Finesse.Label: Finesse
Finesse.Desc: Relies on precision rather than power.

Reach.Label: Reach
Reach.Desc: Strikes at a greater distance than normal.

Thrown.Label: Thrown
Thrown.Desc: Can be thrown to make a ranged attack.

Cleave.Label: Cleave
Cleave.Desc: A telling blow may carry into a second foe.

Piercing.Label: Piercing
Piercing.Desc: Punches through part of a target's armor.

Guard.Label: Guard
Guard.Desc: Aids defense — improves blocking or parrying.

Initiative.PromptHint: Lower acts first. This number is also your action points until your turn ends.

WeaponCategories.MacesDesc: Blunt crushing weapons — maces, clubs, and morningstars that batter through armor.
WeaponCategories.DaggersDesc: Light blades for quick, close work — daggers, knives, and stilettos.
WeaponCategories.AxesDesc: Chopping weapons — hand axes and battleaxes that bite deep on the swing.
WeaponCategories.SwordsDesc: Bladed weapons of the trained fighter — short swords to greatswords.
WeaponCategories.BowsDesc: Drawn ranged weapons — shortbows and longbows demanding a steady hand.
WeaponCategories.CrossbowsDesc: Mechanical ranged weapons — easy to aim, slow to reload.
WeaponCategories.HammersDesc: Heavy two-handed crushers — warhammers and mauls built for raw impact.
WeaponCategories.PolearmsDesc: Long-hafted reach weapons — spears, halberds, and glaives that keep foes at bay.

Skills.AthleticsDesc: Feats of bodily power and control — climbing, jumping, swimming, and forcing your way past physical obstacles.
Skills.StealthDesc: Moving unseen and unheard, hiding, tailing a mark, and sleight of hand.
Skills.AcademicsDesc: Recall of lore, languages, history, and the natural and arcane sciences.
Skills.PersuasionDesc: Swaying others through charm, reason, deception, or intimidation.
Skills.WillpowerDesc: Mental fortitude against fear, temptation, and intrusions on the mind.

SpellSchools.ArcanaDesc: The study of raw magical structure — wards, divination, and the manipulation of arcane force.
SpellSchools.ElementalismDesc: Command of fire, water, air, and earth, shaping the raw elements into spell effects.
SpellSchools.EntropyDesc: Magic of decay, dissolution, and the unmaking of order — curses, withering, and disorder.
SpellSchools.SacratropeDesc: Channeling of consecrated power — healing, blessing, and protection from the profane.
SpellSchools.SinistropeDesc: Forbidden magic of corruption and the profane — necromancy, blood, and shadow.
SpellSchools.PrimalismDesc: The untamed magic of beasts, growth, and the natural world.
SpellSchools.ScriptomancyDesc: Spellcraft worked through written words, sigils, and inscribed formulae.
SpellSchools.RuneScribeDesc: The carving of enduring runes whose power persists in objects and wards.

SavingThrows.ReflexDesc: Dodging, dropping, and reacting fast to avoid sudden danger.
SavingThrows.ToughnessDesc: Enduring physical punishment — poison, disease, exhaustion, and bodily trauma.
SavingThrows.ResolveDesc: Holding firm against fear, charm, and assaults on the mind and spirit.
